ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Via Bitsadmin
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/transfer\\ .*") OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/addfile\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")))
